home.title: Your online catalog, your orders <accent>on WhatsApp</accent>
home.subtitle: Customers build their order in your catalog and it reaches your WhatsApp complete and tidy, with the total computed and the payment ready to confirm.
home.step1: Customers pick products from your catalog on their phone.
home.step2: The full order, with total and code, straight to your chat.
home.step3: Transfer or cash, with receipts and order tracking.
home.noFees: Ready in 2 minutes · No card needed
home.footer: Made for small businesses in Latin America and beyond.
